plain_text: Build a personal notes app. Roles: User, Admin. Users create and manage their own notes with a title and content. Admin manages everything.

cleaned_prompt.Goal: Allow users to securely store and organize personal notes while providing administrative control for note management.
Roles: User: Create, edit, delete their own notes with title and content; View all notes (including others' if shared); Share notes with other users
Admin: Manage all user accounts; View, create, edit, delete any note; Assign roles to users

User Workspace: Share own notes with other users

Constraints: Users can only view and edit their own notes by default; Admins have full access to all notes
Forbidden module: Public sharing of notes without explicit permission
Notes: Domain-specific visual direction: Pastel color palette, clean typography, minimalistic layout
Non-generic page structure: Note list with collapsible sections for each note; Admin dashboard with user management and note overview

functional_requirements.shall: The system shall allow User to Create new notes for User to store personal information.
The system shall allow User to Edit existing notes for User to update personal information.
The system shall allow User to Delete own notes for User to remove personal information.
The system shall allow User to View shared notes for User to access shared content.
The system shall allow User to Share own notes with other users for User to collaborate on personal information.
The system shall allow Admin to Manage user accounts for Admin to control access and permissions.
The system shall allow Admin to View all notes for Admin to monitor content.
The system shall allow Admin to Assign roles to users for Admin to control access and permissions.

non_functional_requirements.shall: The system shall enforce role-based access control for every protected workflow.
The system shall ensure data security and integrity through hashed passwords and secure storage.
The system shall provide a user-friendly interface with pastel color palette, clean typography, and minimalistic layout.
The system shall ensure data uniqueness through unique note titles per user.

stories.story: As a User, I want to create new notes so that I can store personal information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is logged in, When they click on the 'Create New Note' button, Then a new note form appears with title and content fields.
Given the user fills out the note form, When they submit it, Then the new note is saved to their account.

stories.story: As a User, I want to edit existing notes so that I can update personal information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is logged in and has access to the note, When they click on the 'Edit' button, Then the note form appears with updated title and content fields.
Given the user makes changes to the note form, When they submit it, Then the updated note is saved to their account.

stories.story: As a User, I want to delete own notes so that I can remove personal information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is logged in and has access to the note, When they click on the 'Delete' button, Then the note is permanently removed from their account.
Given the user tries to delete a shared note, Then an error message appears indicating that deletion of shared notes is not allowed.

stories.story: As a User, I want to view shared notes so that I can access shared content.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is logged in and has access to the shared note, When they click on it, Then the note appears with title and content fields.
Given the user tries to view a non-shared note, Then an error message appears indicating that access is denied.

stories.story: As a User, I want to share own notes with other users so that I can collaborate on personal information.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is logged in and has access to the note, When they click on the 'Share' button, Then a list of available users appears for selection.
Given the user selects one or more users to share with, When they submit it, Then the selected users receive an invitation to view the shared note.

stories.story: As an Admin, I want to manage user accounts so that I can control access and permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the admin is logged in, When they click on the 'Manage Users' button, Then a list of all users appears with their roles and permissions.
Given the admin makes changes to a user's role or permission, When they submit it, Then the updated user account reflects the changes.

stories.story: As an Admin, I want to view all notes so that I can monitor content.
acceptance_criteria: Given the admin is logged in, When they click on the 'View All Notes' button, Then a list of all notes appears with their titles and contents.
Given the admin tries to view a note without access permission, Then an error message appears indicating that access is denied.

stories.story: As an Admin, I want to assign roles to users so that I can control access and permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the admin is logged in, When they click on the 'Assign Roles' button, Then a list of available users appears for selection.
Given the admin selects one or more users to assign roles to, When they submit it, Then the selected users receive an updated role assignment.

stories.story: As a User, I want unique note titles per user so that I can avoid confusion.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user creates two notes with the same title, When they try to save it, Then an error message appears indicating that a note with this title already exists for this user.

srs_document:
# Software Requirements Specification (SRS)

**Project**: Personal Notes App  
**Version**: 1.0  
**Date**: [current date]  
**Status**: Draft

---

## 1. Introduction

### 1.1 Purpose
The purpose of this SRS document is to describe the requirements for the Personal Notes App, a system designed to allow users to securely store and organize personal notes while providing administrative control for note management.

### 1.2 Intended Audience
This document is intended for:
- Development team
- Project stakeholders
- Quality assurance team
- Academic reviewers

### 1.3 Project Scope
The Personal Notes App will provide a user-friendly interface for users to create, edit, and delete their own notes with title and content fields. It will also allow users to share notes with other users and view shared notes. The system will have administrative control for note management, including managing user accounts, viewing all notes, and assigning roles to users.

### 1.4 Definitions and Acronyms
| Term | Definition |
|------|------------|
| SRS | Software Requirements Specification |
| API | Application Programming Interface |
| CRUD | Create, Read, Update, Delete |

---

## 2. Overall Description

### 2.1 Product Perspective
The Personal Notes App will fit into the user's workflow by providing a secure and organized way to store personal notes.

### 2.2 Product Features
- User Workspace:
  • Create new note
  • Edit existing note
  • Delete own notes
  • View shared notes
  • Share own notes with other users
- Admin Console:
  • Manage user accounts
  • View all notes
  • Assign roles to users

### 2.3 User Classes and Characteristics
| Role | Description | Technical Expertise |
|------|-------------|---------------------|
| User | Domain user | Low to Medium |
| Admin | System administrator | High |

### 2.4 Operating Environment
- **Backend**: FastAPI (Python)
- **Database**: SQLite with SQLAlchemy ORM
- **Frontend**: Standalone plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
- **Authentication**: JWT with bcrypt
- **Deployment**: Uvicorn ASGI server

---

## 3. Functional Requirements

### 3.1 Authentication and Authorization

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Actor |
|----|-------------|----------|-------|
| FR-01 | The system shall allow User to Create new notes for User to store personal information. | Must | User |
| FR-02 | The system shall allow User to Edit existing notes for User to update personal information. | Must | User |
| FR-03 | The system shall allow User to Delete own notes for User to remove personal information. | Must | User |
| FR-04 | The system shall allow User to View shared notes for User to access shared content. | Should | User |
| FR-05 | The system shall allow User to Share own notes with other users for User to collaborate on personal information. | Should | User |
| FR-06 | The system shall allow Admin to Manage user accounts for Admin to control access and permissions. | Must | Admin |
| FR-07 | The system shall allow Admin to View all notes for Admin to monitor content. | Must | Admin |
| FR-08 | The system shall allow Admin to Assign roles to users for Admin to control access and permissions. | Must | Admin |

### 3.2 User Workspace

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Actor |
|----|-------------|----------|-------|
| FR-09 | The system shall display a list of all notes for the user. | Must | User |
| FR-10 | The system shall allow users to create new notes with title and content fields. | Must | User |
| FR-11 | The system shall allow users to edit existing notes with updated title and content fields. | Must | User |
| FR-12 | The system shall allow users to delete own notes permanently. | Must | User |

### 3.3 Admin Console

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Actor |
|----|-------------|----------|-------|
| FR-13 | The system shall display a list of all user accounts for the admin. | Must | Admin |
| FR-14 | The system shall allow admins to manage user accounts, including assigning roles and permissions. | Must | Admin |
| FR-15 | The system shall allow admins to view all notes, including shared notes. | Must | Admin |

---

## 4. Non-Functional Requirements

### 4.1 Performance Requirements
| ID | Requirement | Metric |
|----|-------------|--------|
| NFR-01 | The system shall respond to user requests within 2 seconds. | Response time < 2s |

### 4.2 Security Requirements
| ID | Requirement | Category |
|----|-------------|----------|
| NFR-02 | The system shall enforce role-based access control for every protected workflow. | Security |
| NFR-03 | The system shall ensure data security and integrity through hashed passwords and secure storage. | Security |

### 4.3 Usability Requirements
| ID | Requirement | Category |
|----|-------------|----------|
| NFR-04 | The system shall provide a user-friendly interface with pastel color palette, clean typography, and minimalistic layout. | Usability |

---

## 5. System Architecture

### 5.1 Technology Stack
| Component | Technology | Purpose |
|-----------|------------|---------|
| Backend Framework | FastAPI | REST API and business logic |
| Database | SQLite | Data persistence |
| ORM | SQLAlchemy | Database abstraction |
| Authentication | JWT + bcrypt | User authentication |
| Frontend | Plain HTML + CSS + JavaScript | User interface |

### 5.2 System Modules
- auth: Handles user authentication and authorization
- crud: Handles create, read, update, delete operations for notes

---

## 6. Data Model

### 6.1 Entity Descriptions

#### 6.1.1 User Entity
**Purpose**: Stores user account information

| Field | Type | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Primary Key | Unique identifier |
| email | String | Unique, Not Null | User email address |
| password_hash | String | Not Null | Hashed password |
| role | String | Not Null | User role from architecture |
| full_name | String | Nullable | User's full name |
| created_at | DateTime | Not Null | Account creation timestamp |
| updated_at | DateTime | Not Null | Last update timestamp |

#### 6.1.2 Note Entity
**Purpose**: Stores note information

| Field | Type | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Primary Key | Unique identifier |
| title | String | Not Null | Note title |
| content | Text | Not Null | Note content |
| user_id | UUID | Foreign Key | User who created the note |
| created_at | DateTime | Not Null | Note creation timestamp |
| updated_at | DateTime | Not Null | Last update timestamp |

#### 6.1.3 Role Entity
**Purpose**: Stores role information

| Field | Type | Constraints | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|-------------|
| id | UUID | Primary Key | Unique identifier |
| role_name | String | Not Null | Role name |
| created_at | DateTime | Not Null | Role creation timestamp |
| updated_at | DateTime | Not Null | Last update timestamp |

### 6.2 Entity Relationships
| From Entity | Relationship | To Entity | Type |
|-------------|--------------|-----------|------|
| Note | belongs to | User | Many-to-One |
| Role | many-to-one | User | Many-to-One |

---

## 7. User Interface Requirements

### 7.1 General UI Principles
- Responsive design for mobile and desktop
- Consistent navigation across all pages
- Clear error messages and validation feedback
- Accessible to users with disabilities (WCAG 2.1 Level AA)

### 7.2 Key User Workflows
1. **User Registration**: Landing → Register → Email Verification → Login
2. **User Login**: Login Page → Dashboard
3. **Admin Management**: Dashboard → Admin Panel → Manage Resources

---

## 8. External Interface Requirements

### 8.1 User Interfaces
- Web-based interface accessible via modern browsers
- Responsive design supporting desktop, tablet, and mobile
- Bootstrap-based UI components

### 8.2 Hardware Interfaces
- Standard web server hardware
- Minimum 2GB RAM, 10GB storage

### 8.3 Software Interfaces
- Python 3.10+ runtime
- SQLite 3.x database
- Modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

### 8.4 Communication Interfaces
- HTTP/HTTPS protocols
- RESTful API communication
- JSON data format

---

## 9. Quality Attributes

### 9.1 Availability
- System uptime: 99% during business hours
- Planned maintenance windows: weekends

### 9.2 Scalability
- Support for up to 100 concurrent users
- Database can grow to 10GB

### 9.3 Security
- Password hashing with bcrypt
- JWT token-based authentication
- Role-based access control
- SQL injection prevention via ORM

### 9.4 Maintainability
- Modular code structure
- Comprehensive inline documentation
- Automated testing suite

---

## 10. Testing Requirements

### 10.1 Unit Testing
- Test all business logic functions
- Minimum 80% code coverage

### 10.2 Integration Testing
- Test API endpoints
- Test database operations
- Test authentication flows

### 10.3 User Acceptance Testing
- Verify all user stories
- Test with representative users
- Validate against requirements

---

## 11. Appendices

### 11.1 Assumptions
- Users have internet access
- Users have modern web browsers
- System deployed on reliable hosting

### 11.2 Dependencies
- Python packages listed in requirements.txt
- SQLite database engine
- Web server (Uvicorn)

### 11.3 Future Enhancements
- Mobile application
- Advanced analytics
- Third-party integrations
- Multi-language support

---

**Document End**
